caption:
A bundle analyzer draws your JavaScript bundle as a map of boxes, sized by how much each library adds.

Common finds: a whole date library to format one date, a full icon pack for five icons, a charting library loaded on pages without charts.

Try rollup-plugin-visualizer for Vite or @next/bundle-analyzer for Next.js. Then replace, trim or lazy-load the biggest box you don't really need.

Fewer kilobytes means a faster first load, especially on mobile data.

Source: the rollup-plugin-visualizer and @next/bundle-analyzer READMEs.
